numerator: planned cases with emitted candidate SQL
excluded_cases: cases outside scope or with no approved denominator
unknown_or_na_policy: N.A. when no approved denominator exists
denominator_boundary: Does not alter Track A 120 or other approved denominator

numerator: planned candidate cases that reach execution
unknown_or_na_policy: N.A. when execution unsupported for method/engine
denominator_boundary: Execution denominator remains separate from correctness denominator

numerator: executed candidate cases with result-consistent output
eligible_cases: executed cases with comparable result/checker evidence
excluded_cases: not-run and unsupported cases excluded from executed denominator
denominator_boundary: Correctness gate does not imply formal proof

numerator: verifier-decidable result-consistent cases with semantic-equivalence support
eligible_cases: result-consistent cases where verifier/equivalence basis applies
excluded_cases: unknown undecidable unsupported and no-verifier cases
unknown_or_na_policy: Unknown/undecidable reported separately; N.A. if no decidable cases

excluded_cases: non-consistent untimed unsupported and timing-missing cases
unknown_or_na_policy: N.A. when no result-consistent timed cases
denominator_boundary: Performance only on result-consistent timed cases

numerator: P25 median/P50 P75 and optional IQR over speedup ratios
excluded_cases: non-consistent untimed unsupported and timing-missing cases
unknown_or_na_policy: N.A. when no result-consistent timed cases
denominator_boundary: Performance only on result-consistent timed cases

numerator: attribution-eligible cases with sufficient operator-level attribution evidence
eligible_cases: cases with structured plan/SQL/checker/verifier evidence eligibility
excluded_cases: cases outside attribution scope or private/archive-only evidence
unknown_or_na_policy: N.A. until attribution schema and denominator are defined
denominator_boundary: Explainability does not create correctness or speedup evidence

excluded_cases: target engines or methods outside approved scope
unknown_or_na_policy: N.A. when target engine/scope unsupported or no denominator
denominator_boundary: Separate from Track A same-engine denominator

numerator: executed cross-engine cases with consistent target-engine result
excluded_cases: not executed unsupported and out-of-scope cases
unknown_or_na_policy: N.A. when no target-engine execution cases exist
denominator_boundary: Separate from same-engine Result Consistency Rate
notes: Target consistency protocol must be explicit

numerator: paired source/target speedup retention values or summary
eligible_cases: pairs with timing on both source and target sides
excluded_cases: pairs missing source or target timing and unsupported target timing
unknown_or_na_policy: N.A. when paired target timing is unavailable
notes: Missing paired timing is not zero

denominator_boundary: Diagnostic only not a primary denominator
notes: Candidate Failure Rate removed as primary

unknown_or_na_policy: N.A. unless legacy diagnostic policy is approved
